title: Looking for feedback for our AI-RPG: Battle, Die, Repeat!
author: Lemon30
selftext:
Hey fellow RPG & AI enthusiasts! 

We're excited to introduce our latest creation - "Battle, Die, Repeat!". We aspire to build a mobile game by leveraging the power of AI to bring you an immersive, dynamic gaming experience like never before. We are still on the early steps and this is a new genre of gaming. We will continue to evolve the game based on your feedback to build something interesting and fun.

In the heart of the game lies the Rune Forge, where you'll acquire runes. These runes, essentially some nouns, adjectives, and adverbs, will help you summon unique heroes at the Hero Portal. Each hero's name, description, stats, strengths, weaknesses, and abilities are not pre-defined, but rather generated by our AI, based on the combination of runes and their rarities used in the summoning process.

Here's an example of a hero created by our AI: [Hero Profile](https://i.imgur.com/NG2Bmmb.jpeg)

> Name: Ursula
> Runes: Mammoth, hunter, strong, snow, wind
> Description: Ursula is a member of a nomadic tribe that has survived in the harsh tundras of the north for generations. She has robust body covered in furs and is as tough as a mammoth. She is a skilled hunter and has honed her senses to be as sharp as a predator's. Ursula's upbringing has taught her survival above all else, and she relies on her endurance and strength to carry her through the toughest of trials. Her charisma, however, suffers as she spends more time among her tribe's animals than with people.

Once your hero is ready, they're off to the [Battle Arena](https://i.imgur.com/2n8ttUa.jpg)! These 1v1 battles are simulated by our AI, taking into account each hero's unique stats and abilities. You can see your opponent's rune composition, allowing you to strategize and balance your hero's strengths against the opponent's weaknesses. [Battle](https://i.imgur.com/HwNPLZA.jpg)

We're really proud of what we've built so far. It'll allow us to iterate fast, try new game mechanics easily with decent visuals. The main goal right now is to utilize AI to find some fun and unique RPG mechanics.

Thus, we want your feedback! Your insights will help us improve and perfect this game. If you're as excited as we are to experience the future of RPGs powered by AI, give "Battle, Die, Repeat!" a try! Got any ideas for new features, new game modes, improvements to the arena, let's us know so that we can all look forward to the next version.

Download now for [Android on Play Store](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.arworlds.battle_die_repeat_app) and let us know what you think. The game is in its early stages, so any feedback will be invaluable to us! Feel free to drop your thoughts in the comments below, mail us or write a review on the game's download page.

Thanks for your time, and happy gaming!

comments.author: KefkeWren
comments.body: It feels like a good feature to have would be the ability to use a similar system to add skills and equipment to heroes, which will also be taken into account in battle.

replies.author: Lemon30
replies.body:
Hi, thanks for the feedback. We experimented with skills and they will probably be what we'll add next. 

Equipment is also a good idea. I wonder which one would be more interesting to have first.

We gotta find a more fun battle system that enables more strategization though.

Cheers!
